name: Shadows of Desire
source: The life of a short man is difficult, even more so having a spectacular girlfriend and being surrounded by bad people. Fred is that man, he isn't racist, but the man who made his life a hell is black, he bullied Fred in every year on school but, this year is different, it's their last year of classes and things seem to be going well. Will Fred be able to finish the year with his relationship intact?​
translation: 矮个男人的日子本就难过，要是女友还格外出众，身边又尽是坏人，那就更不好过了。弗雷德就是这么个人。他没有种族歧视，可那个让他的人生变成地狱的男人恰好是黑人，在学校里年年都欺负他。但今年不一样，这是他们在校的最后一年，一切似乎都很顺利。弗雷德能守住自己的感情，顺利读完这一年吗？
